resolved_conflicts.explanation: Central US Lookouts gives 1934 for the steel tower; the county table gives 1935, but its notes say the tower was moved to its present site in 1934. The story uses 1934 and reports the 1935 table date.
The 1964 survey notes say about 100 feet; the same survey's table lists 86 feet. No height_m is recorded because the sources disagree.

sources.title: Mahnomen County Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: Built date (1934 vs 1935) and height (100 ft in 1964 notes vs 86 ft in the county table) are unresolved; no height_m recorded. Newest on-site description is 1964; current status and public access are unverified, so no access key was set. No NHLR or FFLOS registration was found. Wikidata elevation and the Commons photo are already in the record, so nothing new was added to photos.
